meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先自己在真实界面上手动跑一遍 QA 并留下证据,然后只派一个 gate reviewer 子代理(不是一组),审查目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏的上下文和 QA 证据。QA 没有失败行、且评审返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: 刚做完的改动帮我审查一下,先自己跑一遍 QA。
say.note: 先手动 QA,再派一个 gate reviewer。

say.text: 这个分支要提 PR 了,先做一次门禁评审。
say.note: 按目标、约束和 QA 证据审全套改动。

say.text: 把这次 diff 对着最初的目标和约束审一遍。
say.note: 评审会检查安全、质量和遗漏上下文。

howto.what_en: Claude runs manual QA on the real surface itself and keeps the evidence, then spawns exactly one gate reviewer sub-agent to audit the goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Review the change I just finished; run your own QA first.
say_en.note: Manual QA first, then one gate reviewer.

say_en.text: This branch is ready for a PR - do a gate review first.
say_en.note: Audits the change set against goal and QA evidence.

say_en.text: Audit this diff against the original goal and constraints.
say_en.note: Also checks security, quality and missed context.
